purpose: Determine whether Qwen3.5-4B can improve the local BAXY decision model without weakening privacy, exactness, latency or memory limits.
frozen_evaluation_order: Download to a .partial path, require the exact byte count and SHA-256, then rename inside the explicit experiment directory.
Start the current registered llama.cpp b9980 with product-equivalent GPU flags and require a healthy local endpoint.
Reject before semantic measurement if loading fails, the model format is unsupported, or attributable GPU memory exceeds 3072 MiB.
If startup passes, run the existing frozen 45-request semantic development workload on GPU and CPU to compare contract accuracy and latency.
Treat the already diagnosed 19-second CPU gate timeout as a harness defect, not as permission to ignore any semantic mismatch or runtime failure.
Do not open any blind or promotion holdout and do not modify BAXY runtime manifests, source prompts, model weights, thresholds or the MVP.

acceptance_for_future_promotion_work.cpu_semantic_requests: 45/45 with zero errors under the product CPU deadline after the frozen gate defect is repaired
acceptance_for_future_promotion_work.privacy: fully local after the model download
acceptance_for_future_promotion_work.additional_requirement: A distinct preregistered current-tree accuracy cut would still be required before promotion.
